facts.fact: Apple TV+ (Apple's streaming service) costs $9.99 per month, or it can be bundled with Apple One.
facts.quote: Subscription-only ($9.99/month or bundled with Apple One)

facts.fact: Apple TV+ has no advertising, and no ad-supported tier exists, so advertisers cannot buy placements inside its content.
facts.quote: Apple TV+ does NOT have advertising. The service is entirely subscription-based with no ad-supported tier.

facts.fact: Per the vendor, Apple TV hardware is premium-priced at $129 to $179.
facts.quote: Apple TV hardware is premium-priced ($129-179).

facts.fact: Per the vendor, the Apple TV device starts at $129.
facts.quote: Apple TV starts at $129

facts.fact: Per the vendor, the Roku Express starts at $29.
facts.quote: Roku Express starts at $29

facts.fact: The vendor states that the age range 25-54 is the peak period for Apple TV adoption.
facts.quote: Age: 25-54 (peak Apple TV adoption)

facts.fact: The vendor Adwave states that it offers free AI video creative generation tools to advertisers.
facts.quote: Use AI video generation tools (Adwave offers free AI creative)

facts.fact: The vendor's article was published on January 10, 2026.
Adwave's page gives a programmatic general CTV inventory CPM range of $15-30.
facts.quote: General CTV inventory: $15-30 CPM

facts.fact: Adwave's page gives a programmatic CPM range of $25-40 with affluent household targeting.
facts.quote: With affluent household targeting: $25-40 CPM

facts.fact: Adwave's page gives a programmatic Apple TV device-specific CPM range of $30-45, when that targeting is available.
facts.quote: Apple TV device-specific (when available): $30-45 CPM

facts.fact: The page gives a CPM range of $35-60 for direct deals with premium streaming platforms.
facts.quote: Premium platforms: $35-60 CPM

facts.fact: The page states that direct deals with streaming services typically have minimum spends of $10,000 or more.
facts.quote: Minimum spends typically $10,000+

facts.fact: The page estimates that a $250/month budget at a $25 CPM buys about 10,000 impressions reaching an estimated 3,500 unique households.
facts.quote: At a $25 CPM, approximately 10,000 impressions reaching an estimated 3,500 unique households in your target area.

facts.fact: The page estimates that a $500/month budget buys about 20,000 impressions reaching an estimated 7,000 unique households.
facts.quote: Approximately 20,000 impressions reaching an estimated 7,000 unique households.

facts.fact: The page estimates that a $1,000/month budget buys about 40,000 impressions reaching an estimated 13,000 unique households.
facts.quote: Approximately 40,000 impressions reaching an estimated 13,000 unique households.

facts.fact: The page estimates that a $2,500/month budget buys about 100,000 impressions.
facts.quote: Approximately 100,000 impressions providing strong market penetration

facts.fact: The page says CTV advertising costs are $15-35 CPM, depending on targeting and platform.
facts.quote: Costs are similar to other CTV advertising: $15-35 CPM depending on targeting and platform.

facts.fact: Adwave states that campaigns can start from $30 a day with no contract.
facts.quote: Through Adwave, you can start campaigns from $30 a day with no contract.

facts.fact: The page says completion rates on CTV, including Apple TV devices, should be expected at 90% or higher.
facts.quote: Expect 90%+ on CTV, including Apple TV devices.

facts.fact: The page states that Apple TV+ has no advertising and is a subscription-only service with no ad-supported tier.
facts.quote: No, Apple TV+ (Apple's streaming service with shows like Ted Lasso) has no advertising.

facts.fact: The page states that advertisers cannot place ads directly on Apple TV+ content.
facts.quote: While you can't advertise on Apple TV+ content directly, you can absolutely reach the affluent, tech-savvy viewers who own Apple TV devices.

facts.fact: The page states that reaching Apple TV device owners is done through ad-supported streaming apps accessed via programmatic platforms.
facts.quote: The path runs through ad-supported streaming apps, accessed via programmatic platforms that make CTV advertising accessible to businesses of any size.

facts.fact: The page recommends that most small businesses start with broad CTV targeting across all device types, including Apple TV, before testing Apple TV-specific targeting.
facts.quote: For most small businesses, start with broad CTV targeting that reaches viewers across all device types, including Apple TV.
